result.summary: Implemented the minimal LUA-07 second-acceptance-criterion wiring per the validated design (src/design/iss0176-lua07-audit-manifest-hash-minimal-wiring.md). Added src/engine/lua_script_audit.zig with the single exported function executeScriptForAudit (design section 4.1 signature, doc comment preserved verbatim from section 2.2, correctly naming lua_script_execution_audit). It calls lua.executor.executeScriptWithManifest unmodified, then INSERTs an audit row on the caller-supplied conn (no BEGIN/COMMIT, matching recordExecutionErrorEventInTx's convention). Error taxonomy adds exactly one new variant, InvalidInstanceId, returned via a Zig-side canonical-UUID-format check (never catch unreachable); all other errors (LuaError, ManifestError, db.PoolError) propagate unchanged. Added migrations/095_iss0176_lua_script_execution_audit.sql creating the new dedicated lua_script_execution_audit table exactly per design section 3.2 (manifest_hash BYTEA NOT NULL with a 32-byte CHECK, two indexes); audit_entries and audit_log are both untouched. Added the mutation-checkable integration test tests/integration/iss0176_lua07_audit_manifest_hash_test.zig (2 test cases): TC-ISS-0176-01 calls executeScriptForAudit and then independently SELECTs manifest_hash FROM lua_script_execution_audit WHERE audit_id = $1, asserting the persisted bytes match the manifest hash (fails if the INSERT or its manifest_hash binding is ever removed); TC-ISS-0176-02 asserts a malformed instance_id is rejected with InvalidInstanceId and writes zero rows. Also added src/lua_script_audit_root.zig, a small src/-rooted named-module shim required by a real Zig 0.16 module-graph constraint discovered while wiring the build: src/lua/ (which must link LuaJIT) and src/bpm.zig both claim ownership of src/simulation/* internally, so a single compile unit can never import both `bpm` and anything reaching lua/mod.zig — confirmed empirically as a hard compile error. This is why the integration test does not use tests/integration/helpers.zig's TestHarness (which pulls in bpm) and instead connects directly via the bpm-free pool/tenant_context modules; it assumes migrations are already applied (as the standard workflow already does before TEST-RUNNER) rather than re-implementing TestHarness's advisory-lock migration machinery. build.zig gained the lua_script_audit named module (LuaJIT-linked, reused via two separate inline b.createModule() calls so tools/lint_test_wiring.py's proximity check still recognises both addTest roots), the test-lua-script-audit unit-analysis step, and the test-integration-iss0176 step (wired into test-integration-others and zig build test-integration). Verification: zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' output; tools/lint_sql_param_types.py src tests exits 0 (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR); zig build test-env-verify reports HEALTHY (10/10 checks); zig build test-integration-iss0176 against real PostgreSQL (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test) passes 2/2; zig build test (full unit suite) passes 87/87 build steps, 964/1028 tests (64 pre-existing skips unrelated to this change, confirmed by inspection). Confirmed via grep: executeScriptForAudit has zero call sites in processServiceTaskRuntimeInTx or any other src/ file besides its own definition; src/engine/instance.zig has zero diff.
